items.quote: - [x] **LRAG-11**: LightRAG write-side LLM spend is metered: corpus-delete.json and the full-delete part declare calls_llm
- [x] **LRAG-12**: The full-ingest and full-delete admission records number CONTRACT §8 conditions correctly
- [x] **LRAG-13**: GET /health performs no writes: on a fresh, empty store_root it creates no files or directories
- [x] **LRAG-14**: GET /health reports only facts it checked: stores.vector reflects an actual Faiss index probe or is reported as not probed;
- [x] **LRAG-15**: eval corpus_ingest --spend --arm lightrag writes only to the eval store
- [x] **LRAG-16**: Querying a LightRAG arm whose vector namespace (chunks, entities, relationships) has never been populated returns a named refusal
- [x] **LRAG-17**: LightRAG hybrid/local/global answers are generated from KG context as in v1 kg_query: the assembled prompt includes the budgeted entity and relation description
- [x] **LRAG-18**: LightRAG retrieval matches v1 ordering and selection: entity-lookup searches with the low-level keyword string and relation-lookup with the high-level keyword s
- [x] **LRAG-19**: Query traces for the naive/hybrid/local/global LightRAG arms contain no no-op embedder-index node
- [x] **LRAG-20**: The v1 driver ops 'entities' (entity map for a document_id) and 'entity_info' (entity details by name) are either reachable through an engine method plus REST route and MCP tool
